title: Create route
intro: Name it, pick what it is (any number of tags), then tap the map to draw the route and drop markers.
mapHintRoute: Tap the map to add route points. Drag a point to move it, drag the middle of a segment to insert a point, right-click a point to delete it.
mapHintPin: Tap the map where you want the marker.
cloneHint: Pick a public route from your country to use it as a starting point. You can edit it before saving.
cloneNoCountry: Set your country in your profile to see public routes from your country.
cloneEmpty: No public routes found for your country yet.
cloneListFailed: Could not load the list of routes.
cloneNoGeometry: This route has no map data to clone.
saveFailed: Failed to save the route. Please try again.
fileInvalid: Could not read this file. Please choose a valid GPX or GeoJSON file.
tapMarkerToDelete: Tap a marker to see its card or delete it; drag it to move it.
needPoints: Add at least 2 points on the map or upload a GPX file.
fileTooBig: The file is too large (max 8 MB).
pinNeedTitle: Add a title for the marker.
